reference_sql:
SELECT promo_id, product_id
FROM promotion_products
EXCEPT
SELECT promo_id, product_id
FROM order_lines
WHERE promo_id IS NOT NULL
alternatives: SELECT pp.promo_id, pp.product_id FROM promotion_products pp LEFT JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = pp.promo_id AND ol.product_id = pp.product_id WHERE ol.order_line_id IS NULL
SELECT promo_id, product_id FROM promotion_products EXCEPT SELECT promo_id, product_id FROM order_lines

other_way.sql: SELECT pp.promo_id, pp.product_id FROM promotion_products pp LEFT JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = pp.promo_id AND ol.product_id = pp.product_id WHERE ol.order_line_id IS NULL
other_way.tradeoff: A LEFT JOIN on both key columns with IS NULL finds the same pairs, but EXCEPT says the question more directly.
